:::{#def-additive-function}
#### Additive function

A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f: \reals^p \to \reals^m$ is **additive**
[@wikipedia_linear_map]
if it preserves vector addition:
for all $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$,

$$f(\vx + \vy) = f(\vx) + f(\vy)$$

:::
